fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Eight walkers, one guide and a farmhouse in Borrowdale. This is how the three days usually unfold, weather permitting.

default.text: Boots off, bags upstairs, soup on the table. We go through the route and the forecast over supper.
A steady climb on the old slate miners' track. First flask of tea at the top, around ten.
Lunch beside Innominate Tarn, the spot Wainwright loved best. Sandwiches are in your pack.
A table for nine and no walking home: the minibus leaves when the last pudding is finished.
An easy four miles by the lake to loosen the legs, then the 14:10 train from Penrith.
